commitment.heading: Innovate Securities’ Commitment to Investor Grievance Redressal
commitment.body: We are committed to fair, transparent, and time-bound handling of every investor grievance. Complaints are investigated impartially, acknowledged promptly, and resolved in writing — with a clear path to escalate if you are not satisfied. The escalation structure below is the firm’s approved MF grievance process and is aligned across our website, internal procedure, and complaint register.

groCard.heading: Your First Point of Contact for All Grievances

fields.label: Address

steps.title: Write to Operational Contact
steps.detail: Email Mfinnovate@gmail.com with subject: COMPLAINT — [Your Name] — [ARN/Folio No.]

steps.title: Attach Documents
steps.detail: Include account statement, transaction slip, or any correspondence related to your complaint.

steps.title: Get Acknowledgement
steps.detail: You will receive a complaint acknowledgement with a reference number within 3 working days.

steps.title: Receive Resolution
steps.detail: Full resolution will be provided within 15 working days. If not satisfied, escalate to the next level.

includeChecklist.heading: What to Include in Your Complaint
items: Your Full Name as registered with the AMC or KRA
Contact Details — phone number and email address
Folio Number / ARN / Transaction Reference — the specific transaction or account in question
Nature of Complaint — clear description of the issue with date of occurrence
Amount Involved — if the complaint relates to a financial loss or transaction
Supporting Documents — account statement, transaction confirmation, email correspondence
Resolution Expected — what outcome you are seeking
Previous Correspondence — if you have already contacted us about this issue before

rows.examples: Delay in purchase/redemption, wrong amount invested, SIP not registered/cancelled
CAS not received, incorrect holdings, missing transactions in statement
KYC rejection, difficulty in updating KYC details, account not opened
Product not suitable for risk profile, incorrect information provided
Dispute on exit load, expense ratio not disclosed, commission not visible in CAS
Nominee not updated, nominee claim rejected, incorrect nominee details
Dividend not received, redemption amount not credited, wrong bank account used
Staff behaviour, delayed response, incorrect information given

levels.title: Kartik Prajapati — Operational / Service Escalation
levels.timeline: Acknowledgement: 3 working days | Resolution: 15 working days
levels.description: First point of contact for all MF grievances. Operational and service issues are handled at this level.

levels.title: Amit Shah — MF Principal / Final Internal Escalation
levels.description: Final internal escalation for mutual fund grievances within Innovate Securities before external escalation.

levels.title: Concerned AMC / RTA
levels.contact: Contact the AMC or RTA where your investment is held.
levels.description: For transaction-specific issues, the AMC/RTA has direct authority to resolve. Find AMC contact on their website or amfiindia.com.

levels.title: AMFI — Investor Grievance Redressal Committee (IGRC)
levels.description: AMFI can take action against MFDs including cancellation of ARN for serious violations of Code of Conduct.

levels.title: SEBI SCORES / SMART ODR
levels.description: Escalate to SEBI SCORES and, where applicable, SMART ODR for conciliation and arbitration of securities market disputes.

rows.details: Email confirmation with complaint reference number
If complex investigation needed — progress update shared
Complete resolution with explanation provided in writing
If AMC/RTA-level action needed — documents forwarded
If escalated to SEBI SCORES — response by Innovate Securities

investorRights.heading: Your Rights as an Investor in the Grievance Process
items: Right to receive a complaint acknowledgement with a unique reference number within 3 working days.
Right to a fair and impartial investigation of your complaint — no conflict of interest.
Right to receive the resolution in writing with clear explanation of findings.
Right to escalate to AMFI, SEBI SCORES, or SMART ODR if not satisfied with our resolution.
Right to approach consumer courts or civil courts for serious grievances not resolved through regulatory channels.
Right to report mis-selling or regulatory violations to SEBI at scores.sebi.gov.in.
Right to be treated with respect and professionalism throughout the grievance process.
Right to receive a refund of excess charges if any overcharging is confirmed.

closingCommitment.heading: Our Commitment to You
closingCommitment.body: Innovate Securities treats every complaint as priority. We do not discriminate between large and small investors — every grievance receives the same level of attention and commitment. If you feel your complaint has not been handled fairly, please escalate without hesitation. We welcome external oversight and support SEBI’s investor protection mandate.
